title: Study of MDM2 as Prognostic Biomarker in Brain-LGG Cancer and Bioactive Phytochemicals Inhibit the p53-MDM2 Pathway: A Computational Drug Development Approach.
authors: Biswas, Partha; Bibi, Shabana; Yousafi, Qudsia; Mehmood, Asim; Saleem, Shahzad; Ihsan, Awais; Dey, Dipta; Hasan Zilani, Md Nazmul; Hasan, Md Nazmul; Saleem, Rasha; Awaji, Aeshah A; Fahmy, Usama A; Abdel-Daim, Mohamed M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MDM2基因在脑胶质瘤中的预后价值及植物化学物抑制p53-MDM2通路，核心是蛋白-配体（小分子）互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅分子对接和MD模拟方法可部分借鉴，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: An evaluation of the expression and predictive significance of the MDM2 gene in brain lower-grade glioma (LGG) cancer was carried out using onco-informatics pipelines. Several transcriptome servers were used to measure the differential expression of the targeted MDM2 gene and search mutations and copy number variations. GENT2, Gene Expression Profiling Interactive Analysis, Onco-Lnc, and PrognoScan were used to figure out the survival rate of LGG cancer patients. The protein-protein interaction networks between MDM2 gene and its co-expressed genes were constructed by Gene-MANIA tool. Identified bioactive phytochemicals were evaluated through molecular docking using Schrodinger Suite Software, with the MDM2 (PDB ID: 1RV1) target. Protein-ligand interactions were observed with key residues of the macromolecular target. A molecular dynamics simulation of the novel bioactive compounds with the targeted protein was performed. Phytochemicals targeting MDM2 protein, such as Taxifolin and (-)-Epicatechin, have been shown with more highly stable results as compared to the control drug, and hence, concluded that phytochemicals with bioactive potential might be alternative therapeutic options for the management of LGG patients. Our once informatics-based designed pipeline has indicated that the MDM2 gene may have been a predictive biomarker for LGG cancer and selected phytochemicals possessed outstanding interaction results within the macromolecular target's active site after utilizing in silico approaches. In vitro and in vivo experiments are recommended to confirm these outcomes.
abstract_zh: 采用肿瘤信息学流程，对脑低级别胶质瘤（LGG）癌症中MDM2基因的表达及其预测意义进行了评估。使用多个转录组服务器来测量目标MDM2基因的差异表达，并搜索突变和拷贝数变异。利用GENT2、基因表达谱交互分析、Onco-Lnc和PrognoScan来确定LGG癌症患者的生存率。通过Gene-MANIA工具构建了MDM2基因与其共表达基因之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。使用Schrodinger Suite软件，以MDM2（PDB ID: 1RV1）为靶点，对已识别的生物活性植物化学物质进行了分子对接评估。观察了蛋白质-配体与大分子靶点关键残基的相互作用。对新型生物活性化合物与靶蛋白进行了分子动力学模拟。靶向MDM2蛋白的植物化学物质，如Taxifolin和(-)-Epicatechin，与对照药物相比显示出更高度稳定的结果，因此得出结论，具有生物活性潜力的植物化学物质可能成为管理LGG患者的替代治疗选择。我们基于信息学的设计流程表明，MDM2基因可能是LGG癌症的预测性生物标志物，选定的植物化学物质在利用计算机模拟方法后，在大分子靶点的活性位点内表现出优异的相互作用结果。建议进行体外和体内实验以确认这些结果。
